note: Append-only hash chain of takes. Written only by gauntlet/scripts/take.mjs. Each entry's `hash` = sha256(canonical JSON of the entry without `hash`), and `prevHash` = previous entry's hash. Editing any entry breaks the chain and fails CI (GAUNTLET.md §4.D1).

entries.subject: config: move palette halfway to the measured olive/khaki reference values, sun elevation 38°; ledger take-0001 baseline backfill; claims
entries.note: First integrated take after the parallel content passes landed: slab stairs, flagstones with moss joints, white-bark and giant trees with a canopy roof, 500k grass, pod lanterns on the bough, thatch-dome houses, mist and screen-space shafts. Versus the reference: (1) the lantern bough still crosses the top of frames A/B as a thick plain beam where the reference limb is thinner and higher, entering from the left; (2) the grade is cooler and lower-contrast than the olive/khaki reference with its deep cool shadows — palette shifted halfway this take, fog density still lighter than the ~60% haze at 30 m; (3) far hills are untextured grey; (4) stairs and flagstones read too uniformly light with little moss/wear gradient.

entries.subject: ci: do not post the gauntlet PR comment from cancelled runs
entries.note: Take after all eight first-round passes landed and the lantern bough was re-laid to the reference. Frame 1 s vs ours: the bough now enters from the left edge as a ~0.4 m limb with pods near (0.08,0.55) and (0.18,0.48) instead of a beam across the top; stair treads are distinct chipped slabs with dark risers and a grass bank at tread height; flagstones are 474 Voronoi cells with mossy joints; houses have ridged bark, lit doorways and thatch domes with vines. Still different: Saria's house sits in the centre of frame A where the reference has a hedge and mist; far hills are untextured grey; the grade is cooler and flatter; canopy cards near the camera read as large flat leaves; shafts are softer than the reference's hard diagonal slabs.

entries.subject: fable-cursor log: tick 5 — take-0003, B camera, hedge request, round two
entries.note: Hourly take while round two is in flight (terrain lattice sampler, atmosphere GLSL and haze, trees canopy cards and far layers) and with the B camera moved closer to Saria's house. Frame 14 s vs ours: the house should now fill the right of frame with the door near (0.78,0.48) as in the reference instead of sitting small at centre-right; frame 1 s: the centre of A still shows the lit doorway where the reference has a dark hedge (hedge requested from codex); the far hills remain a flat grey band where the reference layers three silhouette planes into the haze; shaft slabs are still softer and the whole grade a notch cooler than the reference's golden light on olive greens.

entries.subject: Trees round two: near-eye laminae instead of canopy cards, boughs over Saria's roof, far depth bands, sun corridors for shafts
entries.note: Round two landed: the terrain sampler now equals the rendered mesh (query-order variance 0, stair/plaza probe mismatch 1e-6 m), atmosphere haze rebuilt on the measured reference (56 percent at 30 m, warm grey #6c6c65 to #91918b, luminous warm sky with no blue), GLSL smoothstep and fog-integral NaN fixed, near-eye giant foliage as small laminae instead of large cards, boughs arching over Saria's dome, two far tree bands north of the log for a third depth layer, sun corridors through the crowns for bolder shafts. Versus the reference: A's centre still shows the lit doorway behind an open terrace (hedge pending from codex), the canopy roof reads paler than the reference's dark crisp crowns because haze also thins the upward rays, and the log arch in D is still largely veiled by mist.

entries.subject: structures: round three — real-scale vine leaves, roof cap, carved sign, pods on short cords
entries.note: Shot A composition fixed against reference frame 1: the lantern limb is re-laid so its midpoint frames inside A (W01 projection 2/3), and a dedicated hedge set of tall dark shrubs on the bank east of camera B sight line now hides Saria trunk and glowing doorway from camera A (region luminance 0.373 vs reference 0.357) while B keeps the door clear with the shrub at its right as in the reference. Structures round three: 7.5 cm vine leaves, pods on short cords, mushroom-cap roof, carved sign. Remaining gaps: stairs sit further left and wider than the reference in A, the upper third is darker than the reference bright haze, the log arch in D is still veiled.

entries.subject: layout: re-lay the hero stairway and camera A to the reference's geometry
entries.note: Shot A re-laid to the reference geometry: the hero stairway now runs almost radially from a level camera A (base 13.7 m away at bearing 55 deg, 3.2 m wide) so it projects to (0.61-0.77, 0.66)->(0.70-0.82, 0.28) against the reference (0.62-0.80, 0.62)->(0.70-0.78, 0.27); a dark hedge on the bank hides Saria trunk and doorway from A while B keeps the door clear; the stair-foot boulder sits at the reference (0.9, 0.7); the lantern bough rides higher with long cords so the pods hang at the reference height; the upper house moved out of frame. Structures round three landed (7.5 cm vine leaves, mushroom-cap roof, carved sign). Remaining gaps: upper third darker than the reference haze, left bank brighter, log arch in D still veiled, canopy pale from F.

entries.subject: terrain/hardscape: warm stone albedo, flat slab tops, banks hug the re-laid stairway
entries.note: Hour 19: hardscape round three against the reference plaza (warm beige slabs R-B 49, dark soil joints, slabs sitting flat): path flattening noise cut 6 cm to 2.5 cm because the old undulation buried a quarter of every slab top under joint fill (the fat joints and soil blobs seen in every take so far), joints 2-5 cm, warm stone albedo (plaza R-B 34 to 43, stone/grass 1.05 to 1.28 vs reference 1.21), lighter warmer treads with dark risers, banks now hug the re-laid stairway and the 2.7 m cliff at Saria pad ring is gone. Composition: two pods at the reference (0.10,0.44)/(0.25,0.45), camera D past the bough tip so the house stair sits at the right edge like the reference, signpost at x 0.58 in B. Atmosphere grade pass (contrast, F canopy haze, far haze luminance) is in the working tree mid-flight; remaining gaps: sunlit pavement too bright in B, grass brighter than the reference in D, canopy pale from F.

entries.subject: agents: tick 10 log — take-0008, measured gaps, vegetation-tone notice to codex
entries.note: Hour 20: atmosphere round three measured against the reference with luminance percentiles: the tone curve and sun-to-shade ratio already matched the reference stone (lit 0.62-0.66, shaded 0.33-0.40), so the grade is now a chroma-preserving power curve with a slight black lift, haze is altitude-aware (uniform to 8 m, scale height 14 m, 75 percent cut on rays steeper than 20 deg) so the canopy from F reads as dark crowns against luminous gaps (F darkest quartile 0.41 to 0.30 vs reference 0.25), ground mist thinned so the log arch in D is a silhouette not grey mush. Remaining measured gaps being worked in the tree: the A plaza sits in the lantern tree crown shadow under the pinned sun where the reference plaza is dappled sunlit (trees pass: sun corridors, thinner low crown in A upper-left, bark #a8a89a to ~#6c604a), and vegetation albedo is too bright (lit grass 0.50 vs 0.34-0.37; palette/material pass).

entries.subject: ledger: take-0009 — A SSIM 0.189 (best), hue delta 0.02 deg in A; monitor 009b818; claims hour 20
entries.note: Hour 21: the A plaza was fully in the lantern tree crown shadow under the rubric-pinned sun while the reference plaza is dappled sunlit (p50 0.55, p90 0.66); two porous sun corridors through the crown now put leaf-dappled sun on the slabs (p90 0.62 to 0.77, pixels above 0.7 from 6 to 22 percent) and on the B path; the lantern bough lobes are thinned so A upper-left reads as boughs with haze between clusters (darkest quartile 0.28 to 0.34 vs reference 0.385); giant bark went from pale grey #cfc6b8 to the reference dark warm #9b7e62. Vegetation albedo measured 40 percent too bright (lit grass 0.50 vs 0.34-0.37): grass/moss/fern palette 0.6x at the same hue band, lit meadow now 0.374 vs reference 0.37. In flight: exposure rebalance because the sunlit slabs now read 0.1 too bright and the exposed sun halo lifts F.

entries.subject: atmosphere: exposure rebalance for the sunlit plaza; god rays no longer wash F
entries.note: Hour 22: exposure rebalanced for the now sunlit plaza. A rays-off decomposition showed the god rays alone lifted the F canopy mid band darkest quartile from 0.22 to 0.43 (reference 0.23): fully lit 50 m columns above the roof plus a 22 percent smear painting sky columns onto the near trunk; the ray march now follows the haze altitude profile and smear taps are weighted by marched-length difference, sky-column share halved. Sun 5.0 to 3.0, hemi 0.95 with khaki ground bounce, haze from 2.5 m. A plaza p10/p50/p90 0.42/0.54/0.77 to 0.37/0.48/0.68 vs reference 0.33/0.55/0.66; B path 0.635 to 0.488 vs 0.483; D arch 0.447 to 0.430 vs 0.427. Regressions from the corridor pass fixed: leaf count 195k to 209k, third bough pod restored out of frame, D purple bed 0.0024 to 0.0061. Remaining: D path in crown shadow (0.31 vs 0.46), no gap glare over the hollow in D, near lantern-tree cluster in A upper-left; trees pass and grass re-measure under the new key running.

entries.subject: ledger: take-0011 — exposure rebalance; monitor 6cc8279
entries.note: Hour 23: grass re-measured under the rebalanced key (sun 3.0): D lit meadow 0.351 and shaded p50 0.275 sit within 0.02 of the reference 0.34-0.37 / 0.24-0.28, vegetation-hue pixels (83,84,53) vs reference (84,84,46), so no albedo change; the compressed lit tail (p90 0.42 vs 0.49) is key/fill/haze, not albedo. Trees follow-up in the tree mid-flight against three measured D/A gaps: the D path foreground reads 0.31 vs the reference sunlit 0.46 because it lies in crown shadow (porous sun corridor over the spine), D shows no gap glare through the roof over the hollow where the reference top band is 0.54 vs our 0.49, and the near lantern-tree cluster keeps A upper-left darkest quartile at 0.33 vs 0.385. take-0011 was the best take in every view but F (A 0.198, B 0.187, D 0.242, E 0.205).

entries.subject: agents: tick 12 log — round four complete, best takes, remaining gaps
entries.note: Hour 0: trees round four against measured D/A gaps: the D path foreground lay in crown shadow (stone half p50 0.416 vs reference sunlit 0.493) so two porous sun corridors over the spine now put dappled sun on the slabs (0.469); D showed no gap glare through the roof over the hollow where the reference top band reads 0.54, so three view corridors from camera D open leaf-fringed gaps (0.496 to 0.509) and the far silhouette rows are capped to 23 m variants so their crowns fall inside the frame; the lantern limb lobes are confined to the middle of the bough so A upper-left darkest quartile is 0.378 vs the reference 0.385. Camera D moved onto the spine axis because our foreground was half grass verge where the reference is all flagstone (D SSIM 0.240 to 0.253). Remaining: B path over-lit under the rebalanced key (p50 0.64 vs 0.49), sharper texture statistics than the soft video frames, and 26 auto-passing items awaiting cross-review.

entries.subject: grade: saturation 1.03 -> 1.12, green desat 0.15 -> 0.08, exposure 0.94
entries.note: Hour 1: shot B path was over-lit under the rebalanced key (p50 0.63, p90 0.73 vs reference dappled shade 0.49 / 0.62) because the plaza sun corridor at (2.5,0,2) cast its lit disc north to z -1; moved 1.5 m south (p50 0.536, p90 0.679) with the A plaza unchanged. Every view read 0.03-0.06 less saturated and 0.01-0.09 brighter than the reference frames, so the grade now runs saturation 1.12 (was 1.03), green desaturation 0.08 (was 0.15) and exposure 0.94: saturation lands within 0.02 of the reference in A/B/D/E, luminance within 0.01-0.06 (C/F still bright), hue delta down in B/D/E, F similarity 0.155 to 0.173. Remaining: C look-back still 0.07 bright and under-saturated, F under-saturated, stone hue in E reads 44.7 vs 51.2 deg (too orange), and 26 auto-passing items await codex cross-review.

entries.subject: hardscape: stone hue on the reference's yellow-beige, short khaki joint sprouts
entries.note: Hour 2: colour statistics against the reference by luminance band. Our soil and joints were orange-brown (hue 34-37 deg) where the reference dark ground is olive (52-57): palette soil to 0x69613c / 0x423b26. The sunlit slabs read R/G 1.13 vs the reference 1.08 (hue 42 vs 47.6 in E): the hue was set by the hardscape GLSL desaturation/lift targets, not the base colour, so those moved to yellow-beige (simulated albedo R/G 1.166 to 1.083 at equal luminance); bright-band hue now E 45.5, A 47.9, B 46.9, D 49.1 vs reference 47.6 / 47.4 / 44.7 / 47.2; hue delta E 5.9 to about 2.2, D 3.3 to 1.7, B 1.6 to 0.2. Joint sprouts shortened to 6-9 cm khaki tufts from 11-17 cm lime blades (817, W21 holds). Remaining: C look-back 0.07 too bright and under-saturated because the airlight ignores view direction (atmosphere pass in the tree), D shade carries more blue than the reference warm shade (fill/IBL colour), 26 items await codex cross-review.

entries.subject: agents: tick 14 log — round five colour passes, remaining gaps
entries.note: Hour 3: the airlight ignored view direction, so the look-back shot C (camera facing away from the sun) read 0.419 vs the reference 0.353 and grey (saturation 0.117 vs 0.170) while the sunward views were within 0.03. Haze, god rays, sky dome and ground mist now share one Mie-like lobe around the sun: warm forward tint, back-scatter falling to 0.62x for haze and 0.45x for rays beyond 135 deg, extinction unchanged. A rays-off decomposition showed the ray in-scatter was the dominant grey wash in C because the old HG g of 0.15 is nearly flat behind the camera. C now 0.365 / 0.154 with SSIM 0.178 to 0.187; A/B/D/F means move under 0.005; sky gap glare #a39e8a matches the reference #aca896 chroma; F hue delta 1.6 to 0.2 deg. This take is the first clean-tree take with the stone hue and directional airlight together. Remaining: A/C shaded vegetation band 58 deg vs reference 51, D shaded slabs bluer than the reference warm shade (fill/IBL), codex cross-review pending.

entries.subject: agents: tick 15 log — fill/airlight tests, remaining gaps
entries.note: Hour 4: colour statistics against the reference by luminance band. A warm hemisphere fill (0xd0c6a6) was measured and reverted: it traded A/C hue for D/E hue and over-saturated E. The airlight was warmed instead (linear B/R 0.89 to 0.84) because the reference hazed regions read B/R 0.87 while our mid-distance band carried nine more blue: hue delta D 2.0 to 1.75 deg, E 2.5 to 2.35, saturation on the reference in A/C/D (0.161/0.171/0.158 vs 0.157/0.170/0.157). Side by side after all colour passes, A matches within sat 0.004 / lum 0.018 and D within sat 0.000 / lum 0.008. Remaining: A/C shaded vegetation band reads 57 vs the reference 51 deg (deep grass albedo hue, vegetation owner), W37 needs the characters and HUD of Phase 2/3 in frame, 26 auto-passing items await codex cross-review.

entries.subject: palette: shaded grass entries warmer (grassMid 0x566021, grassDeep 0x374416)
entries.note: Hour 5: the shaded-vegetation band in shots A and C read 57 deg vs the reference 51 while lit grass was already on target, so the mid/deep grass palette entries moved from hue 79/87 to 70/77 deg (0x566021 / 0x374416): A dark band 56.9 to 55.5, C 54.5 to 53.8, hue delta A 3.6 to 3.1 and C 4.5 to 4.1 with D 1.7 to 1.9. The walkable build is now published under play/ on the monitor branch with every take and linked from the site header (verified booting from the CDN in 13 s, zero errors). Remaining: A/C still 3-4 deg yellow of the reference in the frame mean (their dark bands are shaded canopy and bark as much as grass), W37 needs the Phase 2/3 characters and HUD in frame, and 26 auto-passing items await codex cross-review (offline 17 h).

entries.subject: layout/terrain: log arch 47 m out on a 5.6 m rise (frame 56 s span 0.40–0.75 × 0.27–0.45); path climbs from the hollow
entries.note: Frame-by-frame eye comparison of take-0018 showed two cameras never matched their reference compositions: frame 24 s is the held B camera (E was a ground close-up) and frame 8 s is an eye-level shot dead up the stair axis with the canopy filling the top half (F looked up into the canopy). Both re-aimed and their diagnostic exemption removed: F puts the stair foot at (0.42,0.59) and top at (0.42,0.21) vs the reference (0.42,0.60)/(0.42,0.22), with the plateau fence posts along y≈0.19 and the upper house top-left. C pitched down so the stair foot cuts the left edge at (0.12,0.67) like frame 46 s and a new plaza-south giant stands hazed at x≈0.55 (reference 0.50–0.62). Frame 56 s: the log arch spanned half our frame at 31 m while the reference's spans 0.40–0.75 × 0.27–0.45 with its feet 3.5 m above the camera — the arch now sits 47 m out on a 5.6 m rise, the path runs level through the misty hollow then climbs to it; the small north steps no longer cross the path (frame 56 s shows none) but climb west onto a 2.6 m boulder bank (frame 14 s steps left of the receding path); the spine bears slightly east so B's path recedes at x≈0.35 (reference 0.3–0.6). A north-west-near giant supplies the big dark trunk cutting the left edge of B/D/A. W04 probes 5.09/2.97/1.08/0.00 verified.

entries.subject: trees + structures: round-five passes
entries.note: Trees and structures passes against the frames. Frame 46 s: the centre tree is a hazed bole at x 0.50–0.62 with a Y-fork of spreading limbs — plaza-south moved to 30 m with authored spread limbs (fork y≈0.26, tips ≈(0.37,0.12)/(0.75,0.13)); its trunk box lum 0.359 vs reference 0.388 (was 0.432 as a sharp dark bole at 20 m). Frame 56 s: the left-edge trunk read 0.19 wide with a flared root; slimmed to ≈0.12 (reference 0.11–0.12). Frame 8 s: the reference's top-right is dense canopy (lum 0.35) where we had pale haze (0.38→0.31 after east-giant drooping limbs) and the top-centre gap now reads 0.497 vs 0.483; white-bark crowns reseated out of the gap. Frame 14 s: Saria's roof is a leaf-shrouded crown with hanging vines and a broken dark limb, three pods on short vines just left of the door — B roof box lum 0.388 vs reference 0.384 (was 0.273 as a smooth moss cap), A centre box 0.400 vs 0.396 (was 0.317). Log arch rebuilt with deep ridged bark, fissures, moss cap, splintered rims and a near-black hollow; fence posts weathered two-rail. Still open: the far arch is a pale ghost in our haze where the reference's is a dark silhouette (atmosphere pass running), the hedge still hides the door threshold in B/E (vegetation pass running).

entries.subject: vegetation pass + terrain: hedge capped below the door line, D verges and lavender to the frames; paved east lobe; D boulder bank
entries.note: Vegetation pass against the frames plus two terrain changes. Frame 14 s: the door threshold and terrace ramp were hidden behind our 1.8–2.4 m hedge (its top projected to y 0.25 in B) — hedge crown capped at 0.92 m (tops now y 0.59–0.62, door line 0.54) while it stays the dark shrub band left of the stairs in A. Frame 56 s: our right verge was a wall of 0.5–0.75 m shrubs hiding the hollow and the arch's right leg — everything there is ≤ 0.55 m now; the solid lavender field (purple 2.0 % of the frame vs the reference's 0.02 %) became four clumps at the reference's boxes (0.42 %, above the 0.3 % floor); a fern/broadleaf ring on the shot-D boulder (13 fronds) on a new 0.5 m bank; bank bushes on the boulder terrace. Frame 46 s: a bush 4 m from camera C hid the stair foot — the sight-line box is grass-only. Frames 1 s / 8 s: the right foreground is flagstone in the reference, grass in ours — a second paved disc (5.0, 2.4) r 4 toward the stair foot; right-foreground grass trimmed/darkened; F plateau flank shaded. Regression noticed in this take: with the hedge shadow gone Saria's doorway reads as a brightly lit pale interior (B door box mean 0.404 vs reference 0.299) — structures follow-up running to make the interior dark with a single warm lamp glint.

entries.subject: atmosphere + lighting: single-scattering god rays, darker anti-sun haze, softer broader dapple
entries.note: Round five fully integrated: hardscape, rocks, the doorway fix and the atmosphere pass on top of the frame-matched layout. Frame 24 s / 1 s: our plaza was a tiled floor of same-size pale-yellow hexagons with thin joints — now three-pass anisotropic Voronoi slabs (power-diagram tessellation, no soil holes; plaza joint share 16 % → 8 %) with per-stone tint and outline styles, slab albedo matched to the reference's sunlit stone (sRGB 161,145,107 vs 163,146,107), boulders with bedding strata and olive moss cushions. Frame 14 s: the doorway was fill-lit hillside showing through the trunk once the hedge stopped shading it — a dark vestibule with a raised floor, indoor fog clamped to the doorway and a small lamp on a cord now reads 0.252 (reference 0.299, take-0021 0.404); pods lime/orange/lime. Frames 1 s / 46 s / 56 s: the haze was a flat pale wash where the reference has dark shaded masses cut by slanted beams — the ray march is now single scattering over 40 m through a canopy-gap mask with fixed open columns on the corridors (A shaft region 0.399 vs 0.433 with beams as slanted slabs), the anti-sun haze darker and greyer (C mid band 0.329 vs 0.359, D far band 0.434 vs 0.437), softer broader dapple (A plaza p10/p50/p90 0.280/0.448/0.601 vs 0.235/0.455/0.612). Every view at its best SSIM so far (A 0.225, B 0.211, C 0.253, D 0.247, E 0.214, F 0.208). Open: A sharpness ratio 0.795 sits just under W35's 0.8 (plaza detail); the far arch is still a pale ghost; C's stair foot hidden by foreground ferns.

entries.subject: atmosphere: thin hollow air with a far luminous wall so the arch and far trunks silhouette; shafts import the trees' columns
entries.note: Round six integrated; W35 restored (sharpness A 0.795 → 1.11, every view ≥ 1.0) so this take is valid again. Frame 56 s: the reference's far log is a dark silhouette against a luminous wall (body/haze 0.75) while ours was a pale ghost (0.94) — measured cause was not veil density but the trees' silhouette row 5–10 m behind the arch; the hollow air is now thin (0.02/m) with a far-air knee at 49 m so the 55 m row becomes the bright wall: ratio 0.88, far trunks p25 0.353 against haze 0.58, C mid band 0.368 vs 0.367, D far band 0.429 vs 0.437. Frame 46 s: the stair foot at (0.10–0.20, 0.60–0.66) was hidden by ferns 1–3 m from camera C — a camera-derived frustum wedge keeps everything taller than 0.35 m out of C's left box within 12 m (box 0.271 → 0.320 vs 0.349); the slabs and the mossy rock now show over short turf. Frame 8 s: the right embankment is shaded olive grass at 0.30 — ours went 0.214 → 0.264 with a shade lift and skylight fill, hue 58° = reference. Frame 1 s: fully open sun cores inside the plaza corridors give the reference's bright patches (plaza p90 0.601 → 0.641 vs 0.612); D path corridors less porous (near band 0.433 → 0.461 vs 0.463); six shaft columns exported from trees and imported by the ray mask so beams and canopy holes cannot drift apart. Cost: SSIM −0.03…−0.04 on every view from the crisper 10–45 m band (thinner air adds structure the soft reference lacks).

entries.subject: postfx: softening dialled back so the world-only frame clears W35 (A sharpness 0.773 -> 0.838; 0.9+ once Link and the HUD add their edges)
entries.note: Atmosphere round three. Frame 8 s: the reference has four slanted beams entering top-left (x 0.15–0.35) and reaching the stairs at mid-frame; ours showed none although the canopy holes existed — camera F looks 109° from the sun, so the columns' in-scatter died in the contrast curve; narrow columns now carry a ×7.5 gain, are exempt from the far-air blend and light the air to the ground (F top band mean 0.33 → 0.35 vs 0.39; one broad slanted beam reads where the reference has four). Every view was sharper than the soft 1280×716 video (sharpness ratio 1.0–1.5): a resolution-aware final softening (640-grid Gaussian with a luma-activity gate, depth-keyed haze blur 30–60 m) brings the ratio to 0.84–1.3, dialled so the world-only frame keeps A above W35's 0.8 gate (0.838; with Link and the HUD it reads ≈ 0.9); SSIM up on every view vs take-0023 (A 0.188 → 0.195, B 0.171 → 0.178, C 0.206 → 0.219, D 0.212 → 0.219, E 0.185 → 0.193, F 0.184 → 0.190). Frame 56 s: the far arch carried ray-mask stripes from the plaza columns integrated along D's ray — gap-noise in-scatter now fades beyond 25–38 m and in the hollow, SSAO fades out 22–34 m; stripe spread 0.043 → 0.020, the arch is a smooth silhouette (body/haze 0.895 vs reference 0.746).

entries.subject: layout: kokiri-a steps in front of the stair-foot rock (it was hidden behind it in A); kokiri-b back to the west lawn so he stays out of A
entries.note: Phase 2 and 3 land: the player and the HUD are in every frame for the first time. Young Link (1.25 m, procedural: tunic, cap, Deku Shield with the swirl, Kokiri Sword, 9k triangles) is marched onto the reference's feet mark in each matched viewpoint (A back mid-stride, B/E idle, C walking toward camera, D running, F walking away), Navi sits on her reference ray, three Kokiri kids stand where the reference kids stand (A right edge, B/E left edge, F right of the rock). Hearts, item slot and the hand-drawn minimap match the reference corners. Cameras dropped to the reference's child eye height (1.45–1.5 m): Link spans y 0.56–0.88 at 4.6 m in the reference, which only a low level camera gives with his feet at 0.88; the stairs keep their frame positions (A foot 0.63/top 0.26 vs 0.66/0.28). SSIM up on every view versus take-0024: A 0.195 → 0.230, B 0.178 → 0.208, C 0.219 → 0.253, D 0.219 → 0.249, E 0.193 → 0.225, F 0.190 → 0.216; score 19 → 22/50 (C03 locomotion, C04 Navi, C05 kids auto-pass; C01/C02/U01–U03 await review). Gaps: Link reads toy-like next to the reference (cap, fringe, undershirt, shield swirl); F top-left shows Saria's roof where the reference has canopy; F right bank is sunlit (0.52 vs 0.31); D left verge is lavender-pink (hue 11 vs 55) where the reference has big ferns; plaza slabs are regular tiles versus irregular rounded stones. Round seven sub-agents are on each.
